context.body: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and….

observations.body: Joab recalls Abner, kills him at Hebron, and David publicly distances himself through curse, mourning, fasting, and lament while confessing weakness before powerful commanders.
